title: paraixeris humifusa
intro: Paraixeris humifusa, commonly known as the creeping Oregon saxifrage or creeping saxifrage, is a flowering plant species in the saxifrage family. It is traditionally used in Korean medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and skin disorders. The health benefits of Paraixeris humifusa include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as reducing inflammation and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of Paraixeris humifusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
